title: 第4章疯狂升级

content_zh:
凶险程度堪称禁地。
当年邪魔翻过火璃山脉几次进犯火璃王朝，都被龙家军杀了回去。
唯一的遗憾就是。
在某一次战争中，龙家家主龙战海和邪魔至尊同归于尽，死在火璃山脉深处，就连龙氏传家宝，屠龙刀也随之消失。
为此，龙家元气大伤。
屠龙刀是龙家始祖龙战天屠杀龙神，用龙神精血淬炼而成，乃是至尊神器，是龙家最重要的宝物，也是历任龙神战士的神兵武器，也是龙神战士的象征。
这么多年过去。
龙家从未放弃过寻找屠龙刀，然而数千年下来，进入火璃山脉的人多不胜数，活着出来的寥寥无几，更没有半点屠龙刀的消息。
经过一天半的跋涉，龙飞终于来到火璃山脚下，看着巍峨如同深渊猛兽的火璃山，龙飞双拳紧握，“升级之路就从这里开始。”
龙飞一头扎进去。
火璃山脉，妖兽横行。
妖兽分为一至九级，九级之上就是神兽，神兽之上还有圣兽。
它们体魄强悍无比，碎山断水，在这深山之中它们就是王者，人类对它们来说就是入侵者。
见到人类就是疯狂的追杀。
这里也是冒险者的天堂。
山脉中的灵气浓郁其它地区，天地灵宝在这里孕育，灵草，在这里孕育，还有五级以上的妖兽体内会修炼出妖核，这些东西都是至宝。
除此之外，更要神秘莫测的仙踪遗址，只要寻找到，便能一飞冲天。
龙飞的目的很单纯。
他没有猖狂到进入腹地去猎杀妖兽，而是在山脉外围猎杀野兽。
“叮！”

“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’击杀‘野兔’获得经验10点。”
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’击杀‘野鸡’获得经验10点。”
“在游戏中的话，我还是新手，新手自然要杀这些没有攻击性的小怪。”龙飞并没有因为击杀这些小野兽就没劲，对任何游戏老手来说，金字塔不是一天堆成的，只能一点一点的积累。
两天过去。
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’升级，目前等级三级战士。”
“力量还不够。”
“继续！”
又是三天过去。
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’升级，目前等级四级战士。”
“四级了！”
“还不行，力量还是不行。”龙飞感应自身的力量，同时也查看‘蛤蟆功’用力量释放出来的攻击力，还是不够强。
“再突破！”
十天后。
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’升级，目前等级五级战士。”
“五级了！”
龙飞双目一合，感应了一下力量，五级战士的力量比四级战士强大了很多，随后又查看了一下蛤蟆功的伤害，双眼一睁，“是时候挑战低阶妖兽了，天天杀这些兔子野鸡，都快变成野兔终结者了。”

在他的身后一大片的野兔野鸡尸体。
在他杀这些野兔野鸡的同时，他每次攻击释放‘基础剑法’和‘蛤蟆功’。
基础剑法已经达到三级。
蛤蟆功的冷却时间较长，加上需要一万点熟练度才能升级，目前还是五千点熟练度，离突破还有五千点熟练度。
“向深处进发。”
一路上，龙飞不放过任何一点经验，哪怕是一只蚊子都不放过。
半个月后。
龙飞的修为已经突破到六级战士，也在此时他已经完全进入火璃山脉腹地之中。
“气氛有点不太对啊。”
进入腹地之后，空气中充满危险的气息，六级战士对付一级妖兽还好，要是遇到二级妖兽的话只有等死的份。
龙飞更加的小心。
忽然间。
“吼！”
一头足足有一人高，全身毛就如钢针一般的苍狼扑了出来，两只幽绿发光的眼睛盯着龙飞，两颗獠牙闪着寒光，口水从齿缝中滴流下来。
“呜嗷……”
忽然一声咆哮，一步跃起，飞扑而下，直接朝龙飞的脖子处咬了下去。
“靠！”
“想要吃老子的肉，老子也想吃你的肉，前世可没有机会吃狼肉，现在你就给老子趴下吧。”
“蛤蟆功！”
龙飞身体猛地趴下，四肢摊开，成蛤蟆状态，喉咙里呱呱怪叫，不等那头苍狼落下，身体猛地一弹。

“轰！”
就如炮弹一样发射出去。
“砰！”
击中苍狼腹部，苍狼发出痛苦的惨叫声，龙飞再拿出一根大棒子，对着苍狼的头顶一棒子全力砸下去。
“砰。”
“嗷呜……”
苍狼脑浆崩裂，两眼一翻，倒地抽搐了几下，两眼一翻，死！

content_en:
The level of danger can be called a forbidden area.
Back then, the evil spirits crossed the Huoli Mountains and invaded the Huoli Dynasty several times, but were killed by the Long Family Army every time.
The only regret is.
In a certain war, the head of the Long family, Long Zhanhai, and the Evil Supreme died together. They died deep in the Huoli Mountains. Even the Long family's heirloom, the Dragon-Slaying Sword, also disappeared.
For this reason, the Long family's vitality was severely damaged.
The dragon-slaying knife was made by Long Zhantian, the ancestor of the Long family, who slaughtered the Dragon God. It was tempered with the essence and blood of the Dragon God. It is the supreme artifact and the most important treasure of the Long family. It is also the magical weapon of all the Dragon God warriors and the symbol of the Dragon God warrior.
So many years have passed.
The Long family has never given up on searching for the Dragon-Slaying Knife. However, over the past thousands of years, countless people have entered the Huoli Mountains, and only a few have come out alive, and there is no news about the Dragon-Slaying Knife.
After a day and a half of trekking, Long Fei finally arrived at the foot of Huoli Mountain. Looking at the towering Huoli Mountain like a beast in the abyss, Long Fei clenched his fists and said, "The road to upgrade starts here."
Long Fei plunged in.
In the Huoli Mountains, monsters are rampant.
Monsters are divided into levels one to nine. Above level nine are divine beasts, and above the divine beasts there are holy beasts.
They are extremely powerful and can break mountains and cut off water. They are the kings in this deep mountain, and humans are intruders to them.
When they see humans, they chase them like crazy.
This is also a paradise for adventurers.
In other areas where the spiritual energy is rich in the mountains, the spiritual treasures of heaven and earth are bred here, spiritual grasses are bred here, and demonic cores are cultivated in the bodies of demonic beasts above level five. These things are all treasures.
In addition, there are even more mysterious fairyland ruins. As long as you find them, you can soar into the sky.
Long Fei's purpose is very simple.
He was not so arrogant as to go into the hinterland to hunt monsters. Instead, he hunted wild beasts on the outskirts of the mountains.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for killing 'Hare' and gaining 10 experience points."
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for killing 'Pheasant' and gaining 10 experience points."
"I'm still a novice in the game, so novices naturally have to kill these non-aggressive monsters." Long Fei was not bored by killing these little beasts. For any game veteran, the pyramid was not built in a day, but could only be accumulated bit by bit.
Two days passed.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for his upgrade. He is currently a level three warrior."
"The power is not enough."
"Go on!"
Another three days passed.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to player 'Long Fei' for his upgrade. He is currently a level four warrior."
"Level 4!"
"Not yet, the strength is still not enough." Long Fei sensed his own strength, and also checked the attack power released by the 'Toad Kung Fu', but it was still not strong enough.
"Breakthrough again!"
Ten days later.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for his upgrade. He is currently a level five warrior."
"Level 5!"
Long Fei closed his eyes and sensed the power. The strength of the fifth-level warrior was much stronger than that of the fourth-level warrior. Then he checked the damage of the toad skill and opened his eyes. "It's time to challenge the low-level monsters. If you kill these rabbits and pheasants every day, you will almost become a hare terminator."
Behind him were a large number of hare and pheasant carcasses.
While he was killing these hares and pheasants, he released the 'Basic Sword Technique' and 'Toad Technique' with each attack.
Basic swordsmanship has reached level three.
The cooldown time of Toad Kung Fu is long, and it requires 10,000 proficiency points to upgrade. Currently, it still has 5,000 proficiency points, and there are still 5,000 proficiency points before breakthrough.
"Head into the depths."
Along the way, Long Fei did not let go of any experience, not even a mosquito.
Half a month later.
Long Fei's cultivation level has broken through to the sixth level warrior, and at this time he has completely entered the hinterland of the Fire Glass Mountain Range.
"There's something wrong with the atmosphere."
After entering the hinterland, the air is full of dangerous atmosphere. Sixth-level warriors deal with first-level monsters.Fortunately, if you encounter a second-level monster, you will have to wait for death.
Long Fei was more careful.
suddenly.
"Roar!"
A wolf that was as tall as a man, with hair all over its body like steel needles, jumped out. Its two green glowing eyes stared at Long Fei, its two fangs shone with cold light, and saliva dripped from the gaps between its teeth.
"Aww..."
Suddenly he roared, jumped up, swooped down, and bit Long Fei's neck directly.
"Fuck!"
"If you want to eat my meat, I also want to eat your meat. I didn't have the chance to eat wolf meat in my previous life. Now you just lie down for me."
"Toad Kung Fu!"
Long Fei suddenly fell down, his limbs spread out like a toad, and he screamed strangely in his throat. Before the wolf could fall, his body suddenly bounced.
"Boom!"
It was launched like a cannonball.
"Bang!"
Hitting the wolf's abdomen, the wolf let out a painful scream. Long Fei took out a big stick and hit it on the top of the wolf's head with all his strength.
"Bang."
"Ouch..."
Cang Lang's brain burst, his eyes rolled, he fell to the ground and twitched a few times, his eyes rolled, and he died!
